title: Graphics Quality
summary: In-place L0 policy for the base graphics settings: a High/Low Graphics step, the step a device starts on from its GPU name and form factor, the world render scale per step, and Low starting without shadows.
provides: graphics_device_query: the page's unmasked WebGL renderer and phone/tablet flag
graphics_quality_guess: the starting step for a device
graphics_world_scale: the world target's size per step
graphics_shadows_default: shadows start on at High only
